settings.privacy_body_1: API keys be stowed locally in yer browser (localStorage) and sent only to the AI provider's own API — never to any intermediate server. Ye can clear them at any time by removin' the key and savin', or by clearin' yer browser's site data.
settings.privacy_body_2: This app stows the followin' in yer browser's localStorage: yer theme preference, yer language preference, yer platform filter (Web/Native), yer live search settin', yer sort priority settin', yer active AI provider, one API key per provider ye configure, and yer findin' votin' data (votes, stars, and archived items). No other data be stowed or transmitted.
settings.privacy_body_translations: UI translations an' base corpus translations were drawn up by AI an' may contain errors. No custom or user-entered cargo is ever sent out for translation.
settings.reduced_motion_note: Ye've got reduced motion turned on, an' we respect that. Animations like confetti will walk the plank until ye change it in yer OS accessibility settings.

about.what_heading: What manner o' ship be this?
about.what_body: This here be yer manual accessibility audit writin' mate. If ye've done a few, ye've done 'em all. Mostly. If ye've been at this a good while ye know how often we sail into the same accessibility troubles again and again. I wanted to spare meself the time of diggin' through old files and reports to fish out near-identical issues from past accessibility audits.
about.what_wcag: Coverage extends up to WCAG 2.2 (Level A and AA) across both web and native app waters.
about.step_1_body: Scrawl what ye observed — a component name, element type, or plain-speak description.
about.step_2_body: Use the Priority Up/Priority Down arrows on each result to tune how results be ranked. Star to show first. Archive to hide it, below deck.
about.step_3_body: Select the findin' that best matches. Results be ranked by relevance.
about.step_4_body: Add a location prefix (e.g. "Global:") or use AI to help revise the wording, savvy.
about.feature_ai_body: Refine any findin' description with a short note. Yer API key, yer AI provider — never stowed server-side.
about.feature_languages_body: The UI be available in over 50 tongues includin' RTL support. Switch in Captain's Quarters.
about.feature_party_body: Arr, it be in the Captain's Quarters. Under Ship's Colors. Ye'll know it when ye see it.
about.feature_a11y_body: Built to WCAG 2.2: focus management, live regions, keyboard navigation, reduced motion support, and high-contrast tokens — shipshape and Bristol fashion.
about.coming_auth: Optional sign-in with Google or GitHub to sync yer settings across vessels.
about.coming_custom: Add and edit yer own custom findings, stowed privately in the cloud.
about.coming_ai: Additional AI providers: OpenAI, Google Gemini, and more, arrr.

about.what_body_2: Consistency be the treasure, especially in this industry, and I wanted to make sure I stayed consistent with impact, severity, descriptions, and the oft-times similar suggested technical suggested fix steps. Search this homebrew library of WCAG-aligned finding write-ups, plunder the one that matches yer observation, customize or add specifics to it, and copy/paste it straight into yer audit report.
error.announce: Blimey, somethin' went wrong — the findin' library could not be loaded. Check yer connection and try again, ye hear?
about.sources_body: Entries are written in plain language, near-duplicates are consolidated, and each is aligned to a specific WCAG success criterion. Sources consulted include:
